def descend_tables(c, c0):
    Qc=3**c; PHI=2*3**(c-1); inv2=pow(2,-1,Qc)
    m=3**(c-1); F={}
    for x in units(m):
        t=(3*x+1)%Qc; row=[0]*(PHI+1); v=t
        for b in range(1,PHI+1): v=(v*inv2)%Qc; row[b]=v
        F[x]=row
    level=c-1
    while level>c0:
        mlo=3**(level-1); new=units(mlo)
        rho=(F[(new[0]+mlo)%(3**level)][1]*pow(F[new[0]][1],-1,Qc))%Qc
        Fn={}
        for xh in new:
            t=(3*xh+1); row=[0]*(PHI+1)
            for b in range(1,PHI+1):
                v=(t*pow(inv2,b,3**level))%(3**level)
                row[b]=(F[xh][b]*pow(rho,(v-(v%mlo))//mlo,Qc))%Qc
            Fn[xh]=row
        F=Fn; level-=1
    return F
for c in (3,4):
